svg.title: LEONARD E. MOORE — latest RSS headlines

g.text: Zest’s new AI agent finds restaurants and books reservations over text ◆ Google’s first data center satellite is online and writing poetry ◆ Theranos whistleblower Tyler Shultz warns that the AI boom is ‘a great opportunity to go deceive people’ ◆ North Korean hackers blamed for stealing record $6.3B in Binance breach ◆ Skip the small talk: Make game-changing connections at TechCrunch Founder Summit with Braindate ◆ DoorDash said it’s only received ‘several hundred’ orders from AI agents ◆
